subject: Request: Convert Accelerator Promo Credits to Reserved Discount
messages:
From: Alex Rivera <alex@lumenai.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: Sophia Mendes <sophia@lumenai.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Convert Accelerator Promo Credits to Reserved Discount

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for an excellent demo last week — the latency numbers look great and the embedding quality is exactly what our semantic search pipeline needs. As we discussed with the accelerator program team, LumenAI received $50k in promotional credits from Redwood tied to our cohort onboarding.

Given our forecasted usage for the next quarter (heavy embedding indexing + some streaming for search microservices), we'd like to explore whether those promo credits can be converted to a short-term reserved-capacity discount (preferred) or a one-time top-up we can apply to Dedicated capacity. This would help us stabilize costs while we move to production. Our rough ask: convert up to $50k to a 3-month committed discount, or alternatively a $15k top-up we can draw down immediately.

Deal/Program context: DL-8842 (accelerator cohort #12). Attaching our SOW draft and procurement form for your ops team. Can you loop in whoever owns accelerator exceptions and let us know what exceptions might be possible?

Appreciate any flexibility — we want to close procurement this month.

Best,
Alex Rivera
VP Product, LumenAI
Attachment: LumenAI_SOW_Draft_v2.pdf (application/pdf)
From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Alex Rivera <alex@lumenai.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Convert Accelerator Promo Credits to Reserved Discount

Alex — thanks for the clear note and the attachments. I copied Ben (sales) and Marissa (finance/ops) to help scope commercial/ops mechanics. High level we have three levers we can consider:

- Convert a portion of promo credits into a short-term committed discount applied to Dedicated capacity (would require a minimal committed spend and a signed addendum).
- Issue a one-time promo top-up to your account (simplest operationally but treated as non-transferable credits).
- Approve an exception to let credits be used against Dedicated billing for a limited window (more paperwork on our side).

To move fast, can you share:
1) Expected monthly token/embedding volume for June–Aug (estimate ok).
2) Whether the work is embedding-heavy vs streaming generation (we price differently for embeddings vs generation).
3) Any PO timing constraints (we can prioritize sign-by dates).

Ben/Marissa — can you draft options and the billing mechanics for Alex? If there's an exception path, counsel on accounting/recognition and required approvals.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Lead, Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, Alex Rivera <alex@lumenai.com>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Convert Accelerator Promo Credits to Reserved Discount

Quick commercial sketch for DL-8842:

Option A — Conversion to Dedicated discount
- Convert up to 50% of promo credit value (max $25k) into a 3-month committed discount applied as a monthly billing credit to Dedicated capacity.
- Requires a minimum committed spend of $8k/month for the 3-month window.
- Addendum + signature required.

Option B — One-time top-up
- Issue $10k one-time promo top-up to be applied to either Hosted or Dedicated for 60 days.
- No commitment but promo credits historically non-transferable; an ops exception will be required to draw against Dedicated.

If they sign the addendum by Friday 28 May, we can provide the $10k bridging top-up (Option B) in addition to Option A as an incentive. I can get a DocuSign ready and the finance note for recognition.

Alex — can you confirm whether the credits need to cover embedding extract/transform (large offline jobs) vs production streaming? That changes the unit economics and whether we recommend Dedicated vs Hosted fallback.

— Ben
From: Alex Rivera <alex@lumenai.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: Sophia Mendes <sophia@lumenai.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Convert Accelerator Promo Credits to Reserved Discount

Thanks Ben / Kimberly — appreciate the fast turnaround. A few clarifications from our side:

- Workload split: ~75% embedding indexing (batch jobs to index corpus ~500M tokens over June), ~25% production streaming for semantic search API (latency-sensitive). Embeddings are the main cost driver.
- Can converted credits be applied to embedding unit charges specifically? We want to avoid credits being exhausted on streaming.
- SOC 2 / security: procurement requests SOC 2 evidence and a short security questionnaire (I'll email that to Marissa).
- Procurement: We usually issue a PO after we have an addendum and a clear billing schedule. If you can produce a one-pager that shows the monthly committed spend and the applied credit schedule, that will speed PO routing.

I'm attaching our procurement form as requested. Happy to hop on a quick call if easier.

Alex
Attachment: LumenAI_Procurement_Form.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Alex Rivera <alex@lumenai.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Convert Accelerator Promo Credits to Reserved Discount

Alex — bringing in the finance/ops perspective. Important operational points: 

1) Promo credits are typically non-transferable and expire; converting them to a committed discount is an exception that requires written approval from VP Finance and a signed addendum that covers recognition and reversal mechanics.
2) If we convert credits to a Dedicated discount: we will map the credit value to monthly billing credits (e.g., $25k -> $8,333/month over 3 months). The credits will be applied after usage calculation and show as a line-item credit on monthly invoices.
3) We can scope the credit application to specific unit types (embeddings vs generation) but that requires tagging at billing time and an updated usage export. There is a small ops lead time (2–3 business days) to set up tagging and reporting.

To proceed we'll need: signed addendum (I can draft), PO or signed SOW referencing DL-8842, and SOC2 evidence (link or report). Once the addendum is approved by finance, we can make the $10k top-up conditional on DocuSign completion by 2027-05-28.

I'll prepare the billing one-pager and the addendum draft — give me 24 hours.

Marissa Cole
Revenue Ops, Redwood Inference
From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Alex Rivera <alex@lumenai.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Convert Accelerator Promo Credits to Reserved Discount

Summary and next steps (DL-8842):

1) Agreed path in principle: Convert up to 50% of the $50k promo credit ($25k) into a 3-month Dedicated discount (applied as monthly credits ~$8.3k/month) pending a signed addendum.
2) Incentive: conditional $10k bridging top-up if addendum is signed via DocuSign by 2027-05-28. Top-up can be applied to either Hosted or Dedicated for 60 days.
3) Billing mechanics: credits will be applied after usage and can be scoped to embedding units if you accept a 2–3 business day tagging/setup window.
4) Required from LumenAI: signed SOW or PO referencing DL-8842, confirmation that embeddings are the primary cost center, and SOC2 summary or link to evidence.

Action items:
- Marissa to send addendum and one-pager (in progress).
- Ben to prepare DocuSign envelope for the addendum and a one-line commercial summary for the PO.
- Alex to confirm acceptance of the path and provide PO/SOW + SOC2 link.

Alex — if you can confirm today, Ben and Marissa will prioritize the paperwork so we can hit the 28 May incentive window. Happy to jump on a 20-min call if that's faster.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Lead, Redwood Inference
